description: For pool service, this inspection checklist records water testing, chemical dosing, debris removal, equipment inspection, filter work, seasonal tasks, and customer requests. Its supporting evidence includes free and total sanitizer, pH, alkalinity, stabilizer, temperature, pressure, chemical amounts, and equipment observations.

blocks.guidance: Link this pool service review to the service record.
blocks.label: Pool Service Review Reference

blocks.guidance: Confirm the reviewed pool service location and assets.
blocks.label: Pool Service Context

sections.guidance: Identify the pool service service, reviewed areas, crew, and customer.
sections.title: Account and Service Cycle

blocks.guidance: Mark each pool service item after direct review.
items: Sanitizer, pH, alkalinity, stabilizer, and temperature are recorded
Chemical amounts and post-treatment swimming restriction are stated
Circulation, filter pressure, pumps, valves, and visible leaks are checked
Pool, spa, cover, gates, and service equipment are secured
Debris removal and scheduled maintenance are reconciled
Customer alert, repair referral, and next reading target are recorded

blocks.guidance: Close access and escalate unsafe chemistry, electrical concerns, failed circulation, suction hazard, or uncontrolled leakage. Route unresolved pool service work for review.

sections.guidance: Check completed pool service work by task, room, zone, or equipment.

subtitle: Pool Service Inspection Checklist: residential pool maintenance and chemistry record using pool, water testing, and free.
title: Pool Service Inspection Checklist
use_case: Use the inspection checklist during residential pool maintenance and chemistry record when the pool service record must identify pool and spa volume, equipment, sanitizer system, water features, cover, occupancy, gates, and service history. Complete the applicable handoff for post-treatment readings, equipment status, swimming restriction, customer alert, repair referral, and next-service target.
